orgs.name: OpenMRS
orgs.tagline: Open-source electronic medical record platform empowering healthcare in resource-constrained environments.
orgs.what_it_is:
OpenMRS is an enterprise electronic medical records system designed to support clinics and hospitals worldwide.
It allows healthcare providers to track patient histories, manage clinical visits, and scale primary care delivery.
how_to_contribute: Improve developer guides, Wiki setup steps, and module documentation
Assist with QA testing and report UI or workflow issues in reference apps
Resolve curated beginner-friendly frontend and backend bug fixes

orgs.name: Oppia
orgs.tagline: Free, interactive learning platform making high-quality education accessible to every student.
orgs.what_it_is:
Oppia builds engaging interactive lessons that simulate personal tutoring through real-time feedback.
It bridges educational disparities by enabling learners around the world to master math, science, and foundational concepts.
how_to_contribute: Translate interactive explorations and lesson audio into regional languages
Improve accessibility across Angular and TypeScript UI components
Write automated end-to-end user journey and lesson verification tests

orgs.name: Kubernetes
orgs.tagline: Industry-standard open-source system for automating deployment, scaling, and container management.
orgs.what_it_is:
Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration engine that groups application containers into logical units.
It automates service discovery, load balancing, storage orchestration, and automated rollouts across cloud infrastructure.
how_to_contribute: Review and translate documentation with the SIG Docs working group
Triage incoming bug reports and tackle good-first-issues across subprojects
Join Special Interest Groups (SIGs) on Slack to participate in developer discussions

orgs.name: Meshery
orgs.tagline: Cloud native management plane and collaborative design canvas for Kubernetes infrastructure.
orgs.what_it_is:
Meshery is an extensible open-source manager that allows operators to design, operate, and benchmark cloud-native systems.
It enables visual architecture topology design, multi-mesh operations, and conformance with industry best practices.
how_to_contribute: Build and polish UI components in Meshery's React and Next.js frontend
Refine documentation, configuration patterns, and hands-on developer tutorials
Verify Meshery adapters and CLI commands across different local Kubernetes setups

orgs.name: JSON Schema
orgs.tagline: Declarative standard for annotating, validating, and structuring JSON documents and APIs.
orgs.what_it_is:
JSON Schema provides a clean, standardized vocabulary to validate data structures and prevent API bugs.
It powers API specifications, code generation, and automated documentation across modern software stacks.
how_to_contribute: Write practical schema examples, quickstart guides, and documentation articles
Submit test cases and edge scenario assertions to the JSON Schema Test Suite
Audit validator benchmark summaries and improve beginner walkthroughs

orgs.name: Eventyay by FOSSASIA
orgs.tagline: Open-source event management and ticketing platform powering tech conferences worldwide.
orgs.what_it_is:
Eventyay is an open-source event management platform developed by FOSSASIA.
It provides tools for ticketing, schedule management, call-for-speakers, and virtual events for global developer communities.
how_to_contribute: Develop web features and bug fixes across Eventyay frontend apps (React & Next.js)
Improve backend ticketing and event APIs in Python, Flask, and PostgreSQL
Refine developer setup guides, API reference docs, and localization
